subject: Application: Design Engineering Officer R2799, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for Design Engineering Officer (R2799) at Mildura Rural City Council, seen on SEEK and on the Council careers page. Applications are directed to humanresources@mildura.vic.gov.au.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional work and open to discussing relocation for the right role. The role's focus on road and drainage design with AutoCAD and Civil 3D matches the documentation work in my Advanced Diploma. I do not yet have Australian design office experience, so I would learn Council standards under supervision.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. I will also complete the Job Application Form from the Council careers page. Please let me know if anything further is needed.

Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application: Design Engineering Officer R2799, Marc Darenz Masarate
paragraphs: I am applying for Design Engineering Officer (job number R2799) with Mildura Rural City Council. I saw the vacancy on SEEK and on the Council current job vacancies page, with applications closing at 4pm on 15 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards and construction requirements. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge on construction sites, including inspections, progress records, crew coordination and quality checks. That site background sits beside my design documentation training.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional work and open to discussing relocation to Mildura for this role. I can obtain a Police Check before commencement as required.

The advert asks for a degree or diploma in civil engineering with little experience, plus working knowledge of road and drainage design and of AutoCAD and Civil 3D. That matches my qualifications and tools. I do not yet have Australian municipal design office experience, so I would learn Mildura standards and estimating practice under the Engineering team. I have attached my resume and this letter and will submit the Job Application Form with selection criteria responses as required.
